description: This file implements a wrapper around the Google Breakpad crash reporting library, including functions to initialize the exception handler, add memory mapping info, and handle minidump creation.

classes.name: google_breakpad::ExceptionHandler
classes.description: A class from the Google Breakpad library responsible for handling exceptions and generating minidumps.

methods.name: breakpad_AddMappingInfo
methods.description: Adds memory mapping information to the breakpad exception handler.

methods.name: breakpad_ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Initializes the breakpad exception handler with appropriate dump directory and callback.

methods.name: breakpad_autoconstruct
methods.description: Constructor attribute function that automatically sets up the breakpad exception handler at load time.
